rationale: The agent verified the user via email and matched to a single account before taking any action. It checked order details with read-only tools, confirmed eligibility, and explicitly obtained user confirmation before each write (address change on #W5056519, item exchange on #W5056519, and cancellation of #W5995614). The modifications were executed correctly using the appropriate tools, and the final information (updated address, exchanged variant and price difference charged to the correct card, and cancellation with correct total refund amount) is consistent with tool outputs. One minor concern is the agent introduced ancillary info not shown in the tools (e.g., a 5–7 business day refund window and a claim that the exchange can only be done once), which isn’t supported by the provided tools/policy; however, these did not affect the correctness of the core actions or outcomes. Overall, the agent met the pass criteria.
